p: stranger: That is, the story of such things as came to him and his family as in Ge 5:1
report: He complained of the evil words and injuries which they spoke and did to him.
dreamed a dream: God revealed to him by a dream what should come to pass.
hated him yet the more for: The more God shows himself favourable to his own, the more the malice of the wicked rages against them.
rebuked him: Not despising the vision, but seeking to appease his brethren.
observed the saying: He knew that God was the author of the dream, but he did not understand the meaning.
The Holy Spirit does not cover the faults of men, as vain writers do, who make virtues out of vices.
him into a pit: Their hypocrisy appears in this that they feared man more than God: and thought it was not murder, if they did not shed his blood or had excuses to cover their fault.

Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: Moses writes according to the opinion of those who took the Midianites and Ishmaelites to be one, and here mixes their names: as also appears in Ge 37:36,39:1 or else he was first offered to the Midianites, but sold to the Ishmaelites.
and they brought it to their: That is, the messengers who were sent.
officer of Pharaoh's: Or "eunuch", which does not always signify a man that is gelded, but also someone that is in some high position.
